questions.q: How many bits does one byte take in UART 8N1?
What does a framing error mean?
options: Wrong slave address on the bus
questions.explain: The receiver expected a stop bit and did not see it.

questions.q: Why does I2C use a repeated START when reading a register?
options: To switch W→R without a STOP
To get a second ACK from the slave
questions.explain: Write the register address, then read with no STOP in between.

questions.q: How do you recover a stuck I2C bus (the slave holds SDA)?
options: Raise the bus speed to 400 kHz
questions.explain: Bus recovery is the standard technique.

questions.q: Why is there no ACK in SPI?
options: There is one, hidden in the MISO line
Full duplex with no addresses and no ACK
questions.explain: Data shifts in both directions every clock; integrity is checked by meaning — WHO_AM_I and the value range.

questions.q: How does CAN resolve simultaneous transmission?
questions.explain: A dominant 0 wins: the lower ID wins with no time lost.

questions.q: What is the node ID in DroneCAN?
questions.explain: It is part of the 29-bit CAN ID.
